reason: Plugin primarily provides a DSH web input-side vault panel for quick capture and reuse of frequent items like keys, servers, addresses, and URLs, including auto-suggest from conversation patterns, in-panel search/edit, and one-click fill/send actions, with optional WebDAV backup/restore integration.

summaries.zh: 该插件是 DSH 网页端便捷输入工具，在发送区旁提供保险箱面板，支持记录常用密钥/服务器/网址等信息并点击快速填入或 Ctrl+点击直接发送。
summaries.en: This plugin is a DSH web input utility that adds a vault panel beside the message area to store items like keys and URLs, with quick one-click fill and Ctrl-click direct send from stored entries.

capabilities: Monitor conversation messages for pattern matches
Collect and store user-entered vault records (including private/public items)
Autofill chat draft and trigger submit actions
Persist vault state in host-side store files
Backup and restore vault data via WebDAV network endpoint

reasons.code: README describes automatic sensitive-item recognition from session content (keys, URLs, servers, phones, IPs) and red-dot notification, with manual capture into a vault panel.
README and package metadata show a web client panel injected into the input area between use/usage and send controls, with click-to-fill and Ctrl/Cmd+click-to-send behavior.
README states private records and WebDAV config are stored encrypted with PBKDF2-SHA256 + AES-256-GCM, with auto-locking of decrypted private content and WebDAV backup/restore.
package.json declares DSH web client injection and a bundled patch, indicating host/client integration and file-backed store locations.
